newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaraguans heading for U.S. drown off Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Nicaraguans heading for U.S. drown off Mexico.

text.p: At least 11 Nicaraguans trying to enter the United States illegally died when their boat was shipwrecked off the Mexican coast nearly two weeks ago, officials said Thursday.

News of the incident came from Nicaraguan Foreign Minister Ernesto Leal, who told state radio that a boat carrying 22 would-be immigrants, mainly Nicaraguans, went down November 8 off Mexico's southern coast en route to the United States.
Details surrounding the incident were still unclear. Other versions of the tragedy said more than one boat had sunk.

Eleven Nicaraguan families had reported missing relatives who were on the boat, which apparently originally set sail from Guatemala led by an immigrant smuggler named Julio Quiroz. But Leal said the number of victims could be as high as 18.
